d.t: Washing aid for epoxy joint grouting
d.s: SikaCeram-960 Epoxy Finish is a powder concentrate to be added to the wash water after grouting tiles with epoxy resin. It removes residual epoxy grout haze.
a: Assist with easy removes epoxy grout haze
Simply add the powder to the wash water
us: SikaCeram-960 Epoxy Finish is used as an added cleaning solution added to the wash water when using epoxy grouting. Please note:
The Product may be used for interior and exterior applications.
The Product may only be used by experienced professionals.
d.pk: 750 g plastic container Refer to the current price list for available packaging variations.

sec.t: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to the packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

75–150 m² per container Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply the Product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.
Sponge float Bucket with rollers Grout finishing tool
Follow the mixing ratio of 1 : 100, for example, 50 g of Product to 5 litres of water. Measure out the Product and pour into a bucket of clean water. Stir manually using a clean tool.

IMPORTANT Risk of staining on natural stone Using the Product on natural stone may result in surface staining. Do not use the Product in combination with natural stone. Apply on a test area if in doubt. Protect the Product from moisture Note: Reseal open containers. Preconditions Observe information such as waiting times in the Product Data Sheet of the joint grouting product. Use a sponge float to wash the surface of the tiles. IMPORTANT Rinse the sponge and change the wash water frequently. Remove any smears or remaining haze. Allow the surface to dry. Repeat the cleaning process if there is any remaining epoxy grout haze.
Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.

handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.
